title: Plan Assign dropdown (Auto/Manually) does not close on Escape
notes:
Pre-existing (identical code). Keyboard Shortcuts pane says Esc closes menus; the Ready-to-Assign Assign dropdown only closes on an outside click.
Fixed on tk/budget-sfa: AssignDropdownBody uses ui/escapeToClose (capture listener, decision deferred so an open To select or the quick-math editor can claim Escape first). Unit-tested (escapeToClose.test.ts); browser check in the final regression pass.
